    function shouldShowAnnouncementBar() {
      try {
        if (!window.Static.SQUARESPACE_CONTEXT.showAnnouncementBar) {
          return false;
        }
        var localDataStr = localStorage.getItem('squarespace-announcement-bar');
        if (localDataStr && JSON.parse(localDataStr).closed) {
          return false;
        }
        return true;
      } catch(e) {
        console.error(e);
        return true;
      }
    }
    if (shouldShowAnnouncementBar()) {
      document.body.classList.add('announcement-bar-reserved-space');

    <script>
      (function() {
        var header = document.getElementById('header');
        if (!header) {
          return;
        }
        function setHeaderHeightVar() {
          document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
            '--header-height',
            header.getBoundingClientRect().height + 'px'
          );
        }
        setHeaderHeightVar();
        var images = header.getElementsByTagName('img');
        for (var i = 0; i < images.length; i++) {
          if (!images[i].complete) {
            images[i].addEventListener('load', setHeaderHeightVar);
          }
        }
      })();
      //# sourceURL=reserveSpaceForHeader.js

		<script type ="text/javascript">
	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});

		        (function($){ //create closure so we can safely use $ as alias for jQuery
		            $(document).ready(function(){
													var pathname = window.location.href;
							if(pathname.search(/#/)!=-1) pathname=pathname.slice(0,pathname.search(/#/));
							$('a').each(function () {
							   var link = $(this).attr('href');
							   if(typeof(link)!='undefined'){
								   if (link.substr(0,1) == "#" ) {
									   $(this).attr('href', pathname + link);
								   }
							   }
							});
						
		            });
		        })(jQuery);
		    </script>
		
		
		
		
		<script type ="text/javascript">
	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});

		<script type ="text/javascript">
	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

		<script type ="text/javascript">
	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

	function verifyLogin(which) {
		with(which) {
			if(username.value == '' || password.value == ''){
				alert("Please enter your username and password to login");
				return false;
			} else {
				return true;
			}
		}

		<script type ="text/javascript">
	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

    function replaceSponsorImageTickerElements1() {
            var id_img_array = ['Dayton_IFMA_WESHorizontal_LOGO_2.jpg'];
            var id_link_array = ['ad-click.php?id=41&source=rotator'];
            var id_target_array = ['_self'];

            for (let i = id_img_array.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                [id_img_array[i], id_img_array[j]] = [id_img_array[j], id_img_array[i]];
                [id_link_array[i], id_link_array[j]] = [id_link_array[j], id_link_array[i]];
                [id_target_array[i], id_target_array[j]] = [id_target_array[j], id_target_array[i]];
            }


            var container = document.getElementById("sponsorTicker_1");
            if (!container) return;
            var links = container.querySelectorAll("a");
            links.forEach(function(link, index) {
                var img = link.querySelector("img");
                if (img) {
                    img.src = 'https://dayton-ifma.starchapter.com/images/sponsors/' + id_img_array[index];
                    link.href = id_link_array[index];
                    link.target = id_target_array[index];
                }
            });
    }
    jQuery(document).ready(function(){
        replaceSponsorImageTickerElements1();
    });

</script>

	function verifyLogin(which) {
		with(which) {
			if(username.value == '' || password.value == ''){
				alert("Please enter your username and password to login");
				return false;
			} else {
				return true;
			}
		}

		<script type ="text/javascript">
	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

    function replaceSponsorImageTickerElements1() {
            var id_img_array = ['corporate-care.jpg','valley-relocation.jpg','Sherwin_logo.png','HCI_logo.png','atco_logo.png','SVM_logo.png','Janus-Corporation.jpg'];
            var id_link_array = ['ad-click.php?id=1&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=2&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=14&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=15&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=16&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=24&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=29&source=rotator'];
            var id_target_array = ['_self','_self','_self','_self','_self','_self','_self'];

            for (let i = id_img_array.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                [id_img_array[i], id_img_array[j]] = [id_img_array[j], id_img_array[i]];
                [id_link_array[i], id_link_array[j]] = [id_link_array[j], id_link_array[i]];
                [id_target_array[i], id_target_array[j]] = [id_target_array[j], id_target_array[i]];
            }


            var container = document.getElementById("sponsorTicker_1");
            if (!container) return;
            var links = container.querySelectorAll("a");
            links.forEach(function(link, index) {
                var img = link.querySelector("img");
                if (img) {
                    img.src = 'https://ifmaeb.starchapter.com/images/sponsors/' + id_img_array[index];
                    link.href = id_link_array[index];
                    link.target = id_target_array[index];
                }
            });
    }
    jQuery(document).ready(function(){
        replaceSponsorImageTickerElements1();
    });

</script>

	function verifyLogin(which) {
		with(which) {
			if(username.value == '' || password.value == ''){
				alert("Please enter your username and password to login");
				return false;
			} else {
				return true;
			}
		}
	}

                    var orientation = window.orientation;

                    switch(orientation) {
                        case 0:
                        case 90:
                        case -90: window.location.reload();
                            break;

                $(document).ready(function(){
                    $('.sf-with-ul').ready(function(){
                        $('.sf-with-ul, .sf-menu').on('mouseenter mouseout', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });

                        
                        $('.sf-with-ul').on('click touchend', function (e) {
                            if(e.type == 'touchend') {
                                isTouchStartDetected = true;
                            }

                            if(e.type == 'click' && isTouchStartDetected) {
                                return false;
                            }

                            //alert(e.type)
                            //$(this).parent().siblings().removeClass('sfHover');
                            //$(this).parent().siblings().children('.sf-menu').css({display: 'none'});
                            //$(this).parent().toggleClass('sfHover');

                            if($(this).parent().hasClass('sfHover')) {
                                $(this).siblings('.sf-menu').css({display: 'block'});
                                $(this).parent().toggleClass('sfHover');
                            } else {
                                $(this).siblings('.sf-menu').css({display: 'none'});
                            }
                        })
                    });
                });
            })(jQuery);

							if(pathname.search(/#/)!=-1) pathname=pathname.slice(0,pathname.search(/#/));
							$('a').each(function () {
							   var link = $(this).attr('href');
							   if(typeof(link)!='undefined'){
								   if (link.substr(0,1) == "#" ) {

							});

		<script type ="text/javascript">
	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

<script>
	function verifyLogin(which) {
		with(which) {
			if(username.value == '' || password.value == ''){
				alert("Please enter your username and password to login");
				return false;
			} else {
				return true;
			}
		}
	}
</script>

                        $('.sf-with-ul').on('click touchend', function (e) {
                            if(e.type == 'touchend') {

                            }

		        (function($){ //create closure so we can safely use $ as alias for jQuery
		            $(document).ready(function(){
													var pathname = window.location.href;
							if(pathname.search(/#/)!=-1) pathname=pathname.slice(0,pathname.search(/#/));
							$('a').each(function () {
							   var link = $(this).attr('href');
							   if(typeof(link)!='undefined'){
								   if (link.substr(0,1) == "#" ) {
									   $(this).attr('href', pathname + link);
								   }
							   }
							});
						
		            });
		        })(jQuery);
		    </script>
		
		
		
		
		<script type ="text/javascript">
	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

	function verifyLogin(which) {
		with(which) {
			if(username.value == '' || password.value == ''){
				alert("Please enter your username and password to login");
				return false;
			} else {
				return true;
			}
		}
	}

		        (function($){ //create closure so we can safely use $ as alias for jQuery
		            $(document).ready(function(){
													var pathname = window.location.href;
							if(pathname.search(/#/)!=-1) pathname=pathname.slice(0,pathname.search(/#/));
							$('a').each(function () {
							   var link = $(this).attr('href');
							   if(typeof(link)!='undefined'){
								   if (link.substr(0,1) == "#" ) {
									   $(this).attr('href', pathname + link);
								   }
							   }
							});
						
		            });
		        })(jQuery);
		    </script>
		
		
		
		
		<script type ="text/javascript">
	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

	function verifyLogin(which) {
		with(which) {
			if(username.value == '' || password.value == ''){
				alert("Please enter your username and password to login");
				return false;
			} else {
				return true;
			}
		}
	}

            // Navigation to open on click for the M2 series layout
            var isTouchStartDetected = false;

            (function($){
                window.onorientationchange = function() {
                    var orientation = window.orientation;

                    switch(orientation) {
                        case 0:
                        case 90:
                        case -90: window.location.reload();
                            break;
                    }
                };

                $(document).ready(function(){
                    $('.sf-with-ul').ready(function(){
                        $('.sf-with-ul, .sf-menu').on('mouseenter mouseout', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });

                        
                        $('.sf-with-ul').on('click touchend', function (e) {
                            if(e.type == 'touchend') {
                                isTouchStartDetected = true;
                            }

                            if(e.type == 'click' && isTouchStartDetected) {
                                return false;
                            }

                            //alert(e.type)
                            //$(this).parent().siblings().removeClass('sfHover');
                            //$(this).parent().siblings().children('.sf-menu').css({display: 'none'});
                            //$(this).parent().toggleClass('sfHover');

                            if($(this).parent().hasClass('sfHover')) {
                                $(this).siblings('.sf-menu').css({display: 'block'});
                                $(this).parent().toggleClass('sfHover');
                            } else {
                                $(this).siblings('.sf-menu').css({display: 'none'});
                            }
                        })
                    });
                });
            })(jQuery);
        </script>

		<script type ="text/javascript">
	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

	function showHiddenHorizontalElements1() {
		var hiddenElementIds = ['horizontal_1_0'];
		for (let i = hiddenElementIds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
			const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
			[hiddenElementIds[i], hiddenElementIds[j]] = [hiddenElementIds[j], hiddenElementIds[i]];
		}

		hiddenElementIds = hiddenElementIds.slice(0, 1);

		hiddenElementIds.forEach(function(id) {
			var element = document.getElementById(id);
			if (element) {
				element.classList.remove('hide');
				element.classList.add('show');
			}
		});
	}
	jQuery(document).ready(function(){
		showHiddenHorizontalElements1();
	});
</script>

	function verifyLogin(which) {
		with(which) {
			if(username.value == '' || password.value == ''){
				alert("Please enter your username and password to login");
				return false;
			} else {
				return true;
			}
		}
	}

( ( dropdownId ) => {
	const dropdown = document.getElementById( dropdownId );
	function onSelectChange() {
		setTimeout( () => {
			if ( 'escape' === dropdown.dataset.lastkey ) {
				return;
			}
			if ( dropdown.value ) {
				document.location.href = dropdown.value;
			}
		}, 250 );
	}
	function onKeyUp( event ) {
		if ( 'Escape' === event.key ) {
			dropdown.dataset.lastkey = 'escape';
		} else {
			delete dropdown.dataset.lastkey;
		}
	}
	function onClick() {
		delete dropdown.dataset.lastkey;
	}
	dropdown.addEventListener( 'keyup', onKeyUp );
	dropdown.addEventListener( 'click', onClick );
	dropdown.addEventListener( 'change', onSelectChange );
})( "archives-dropdown--1" );

		<script type ="text/javascript">
	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

		        (function($){ //create closure so we can safely use $ as alias for jQuery
		            $(document).ready(function(){
													var pathname = window.location.href;
							if(pathname.search(/#/)!=-1) pathname=pathname.slice(0,pathname.search(/#/));
							$('a').each(function () {
							   var link = $(this).attr('href');
							   if(typeof(link)!='undefined'){
								   if (link.substr(0,1) == "#" ) {
									   $(this).attr('href', pathname + link);
								   }
							   }
							});
						
		            });
		        })(jQuery);
		    </script>
		
		
		
		
		<script type ="text/javascript">
	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

		            $(document).ready(function(){
													var pathname = window.location.href;
							if(pathname.search(/#/)!=-1) pathname=pathname.slice(0,pathname.search(/#/));
							$('a').each(function () {
							   var link = $(this).attr('href');
							   if(typeof(link)!='undefined'){
								   if (link.substr(0,1) == "#" ) {
									   $(this).attr('href', pathname + link);
								   }
							   }
							});
						
		            });

		<script type ="text/javascript">
	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

					    <script type="text/javascript">
		        (function($){ //create closure so we can safely use $ as alias for jQuery
		            $(document).ready(function(){
													var pathname = window.location.href;
							if(pathname.search(/#/)!=-1) pathname=pathname.slice(0,pathname.search(/#/));
							$('a').each(function () {
							   var link = $(this).attr('href');
							   if(typeof(link)!='undefined'){
								   if (link.substr(0,1) == "#" ) {
									   $(this).attr('href', pathname + link);
								   }
							   }
							});
						
		            });
		        })(jQuery);

    function replaceSponsorImageTickerElements1() {
            var id_img_array = ['5.png','Rinderle_Door_Co_Logo_New_2011-2013.jpg','6.png','7.png','selzer_ornst_3_2.png','v_amp_f.jpeg','2.png','1_2.png','SEWIFMA_Annual_Sponsor__2_.png','Bottleless_NationCenterStack_WithTaglineA.jpg','CECLogo2025.png','ElevatedEquipmentRentals_Logo.png','LSHC_Logo.png','Metro_Elevator.png','NEXTLogo_Pantone_All_Blue.jpg','Uihlein_Electric_Logo.png'];
            var id_link_array = ['ad-click.php?id=5&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=8&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=9&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=21&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=37&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=49&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=58&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=59&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=47&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=62&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=63&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=64&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=65&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=66&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=67&source=rotator','ad-click.php?id=60&source=rotator'];
            var id_target_array = ['_blank','_blank','_blank','_blank','_blank','_blank','_blank','_blank','_blank','_blank','_blank','_blank','_blank','_blank','_blank','_blank'];

            for (let i = id_img_array.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                [id_img_array[i], id_img_array[j]] = [id_img_array[j], id_img_array[i]];
                [id_link_array[i], id_link_array[j]] = [id_link_array[j], id_link_array[i]];
                [id_target_array[i], id_target_array[j]] = [id_target_array[j], id_target_array[i]];
            }


            var container = document.getElementById("sponsorTicker_1");
            if (!container) return;
            var links = container.querySelectorAll("a");
            links.forEach(function(link, index) {
                var img = link.querySelector("img");
                if (img) {
                    img.src = 'https://sewifma.starchapter.com/images/sponsors/' + id_img_array[index];
                    link.href = id_link_array[index];
                    link.target = id_target_array[index];
                }
            });
    }

	function verifyLogin(which) {
		with(which) {
			if(username.value == '' || password.value == ''){

				return false;
			} else {
				return true;
			}
		}

            var isTouchStartDetected = false;

            (function($){
                window.onorientationchange = function() {
                    var orientation = window.orientation;

                    switch(orientation) {
                        case 0:
                        case 90:
                        case -90: window.location.reload();
                            break;
                    }
                };

                $(document).ready(function(){
                    $('.sf-with-ul').ready(function(){
                        $('.sf-with-ul, .sf-menu').on('mouseenter mouseout', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });

                        
                        $('.sf-with-ul').on('click touchend', function (e) {
                            if(e.type == 'touchend') {
                                isTouchStartDetected = true;
                            }

                            if(e.type == 'click' && isTouchStartDetected) {
                                return false;
                            }

                            //alert(e.type)
                            //$(this).parent().siblings().removeClass('sfHover');
                            //$(this).parent().siblings().children('.sf-menu').css({display: 'none'});
                            //$(this).parent().toggleClass('sfHover');

                            if($(this).parent().hasClass('sfHover')) {
                                $(this).siblings('.sf-menu').css({display: 'block'});
                                $(this).parent().toggleClass('sfHover');
                            } else {
                                $(this).siblings('.sf-menu').css({display: 'none'});
                            }
                        })
                    });
                });
            })(jQuery);
        </script>

		        (function($){ //create closure so we can safely use $ as alias for jQuery
		            $(document).ready(function(){
													var pathname = window.location.href;
							if(pathname.search(/#/)!=-1) pathname=pathname.slice(0,pathname.search(/#/));
							$('a').each(function () {
							   var link = $(this).attr('href');
							   if(typeof(link)!='undefined'){
								   if (link.substr(0,1) == "#" ) {
									   $(this).attr('href', pathname + link);
								   }
							   }
							});
						
		            });
		        })(jQuery);

		<script type ="text/javascript">
	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

	function verifyLogin(which) {
		with(which) {
			if(username.value == '' || password.value == ''){
				alert("Please enter your username and password to login");
				return false;
			} else {
				return true;
			}
		}
	}

	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>

	function verifyLogin(which) {
		with(which) {
			if(username.value == '' || password.value == ''){

				return false;
			} else {
				return true;
			}

		<script type ="text/javascript">
	var mobile_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var tablet_hamburger_enabled = true;
	var main_navbar_selector = '#main-navbar .sf-menu.sf-js-enabled';
	var window_width = jQuery(window).width(), window_height = jQuery(window).height();

	function hamburgerServiceTrigger() {
	    var size = window.getComputedStyle(document.body,':after').content.replace(/"|'/g, '');

	    if (size == 'mobile' && !mobile_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else if (size == 'tablet' && !tablet_hamburger_enabled) {
	        jQuery(main_navbar_selector).addClass('show');
	    } else {
	    	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).removeClass('show');
	    }
	}

	jQuery(window).on('resize', function(){
		if(jQuery(window).width() != window_width || jQuery(window).height() != window_height){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}
	});

	jQuery(main_navbar_selector).ready(function(){
		setTimeout(function(){
			hamburgerServiceTrigger();
		}, 500);	
	});
</script>
